nameOrigin: animal fat used to make candles

pokedexEntries.sc: It is said that a dog Pokémon that died in the wild without ever interacting with a human was reborn as this Pokémon.

pokedexEntries.vi: This friendly Pokémon doesn’t like being alone. Pay it even the slightest bit of attention, and it will follow you forever.

pokedexEntries.za: This Pokémon loves to gambol and roughhouse. It rubs its fur up against others and absorbs their life force until they're utterly drained.
